skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts, characteristics, and importance of resource management.
Apply knowledge to identify resource management contents.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analysis and Application of Management Tools
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze and apply various management tools in resource management.
Demonstrate ability to work individually and in groups on economic, financial, and business issues using resource management tools.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and solve problems related to resource management.
Work collaboratively in teams to solve problems related to resource management.
Effectively present research findings and engage in discussions.
Demonstrate self-learning abilities to independently study and improve resource management knowledge.
